title: [LOGGED OUT] Mobile burger menu "Store" opens the Store page
reason: Burger menu Store opens /store/ with heading LUDUS・Official Webshop. Mobile via Chrome mobileEmulation fallback (390x844, DPR 3, iPhone UA), not emulate_device.

steps.text: Open https://site.ludus-game.com/ in the browser on a phone screen (iPhone 14 size, 390x844) and wait until the page has finished loading.
steps.saw: Home page loaded at 390px wide; cookie banner and "Add It to Home Screen" banner visible.

steps.text: If a "How we use cookies" banner is shown, click "Dismiss".
steps.saw: Cookie banner shown; clicked Dismiss, banner closed.

steps.text: If an "Add It to Home Screen" banner is shown at the bottom, click its X (close) button. Do not click "Claim" on that banner.
steps.saw: Banner shown; clicked its X ("Close pwa banner"), banner gone. Claim not clicked.
Menu opened: Home, Store, Reward chain, Clan reward, Loyalty shop, Login.
Clicked Store link in the menu; navigated to https://site.ludus-game.com/store/.
First heading (H3) text "LUDUS・Official Webshop" shown at top of the page, subtitle "Enjoy lower prices - buy game resources and passes much cheaper!".
